svg.title: The Haunted Archive
svg.desc: Seven public GitHub statistics and a code-language pie chart. ISSUES RAISED: 1. PULL REQUESTS: 2. PRS MERGED: 2. STARS EARNED: 2. REPOSITORIES: 4. CONTRIBUTIONS: 548. LONGEST STREAK: 18. Longest streak and contributions cover the past twelve months. The resident ghost floats by the doorway. A black cat sits beside the pumpkin, blinks and moves its tail. A spider crawls on the beam, the lantern flickers, and red eyes watch from the doorway.

g.aria-label: The resident keeps a record of everything.
